args.description: Any JSON value, available in the code as `args`.

code.description: Body of an async function. Example: const w = await h.wires('GND'); return w.length;

maxChars.description: Inline result limit (default 12000); larger results are saved to a file and previewed.

saveTo.description: Absolute path: save the result (or the returned File) there instead of returning it inline.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit in ms (default 30000). Code that times out keeps running in EasyEDA.

name: eda_exec
